title: Android 10 with Pixel 3XL
body: I'm currently using xdrip+ with Android 10 on Pixel 3XL. Since upgrading to Android 10, I haven't had a successful sensor. I've changed my Bluetooth AVRCP to 1.3 and it didn't do anything. I've enabled OB1 debugging and it hasn't done anything. It shows my transmitter is connected in xdrip+ but it won't show it connected under my Bluetooth setting in my phone. My transmitter is 8K____.

comments.body: Which version of xDrip+ are you using? Can you also submit logs as you have enabled the extra debugging. thank you

That is the firmware version of the transmitter. The xDrip version is visible in the classic status page or when you submit logs automatically. To submit logs just use the event viewer from the right menu on the xDrip main page and then hit the upload logs button. Add some kind of identifier so I can locate them easily. thanks

Version code: 1910271159
Uploaded logs with Android 10 problem #1254

I suggest you update to the latest nightly or alpha version as there isn't any android 10 or 2.18.2.xx firmware support in the version you're using.

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/How-to-get-the-Nightlies-on-Automatic-Update
I've updated to the latest. It's still telling me that the sensor is stopped but it's still connecting to it.

I think from what you're saying that the transmitter has the sensor session started but xDrip doesn't. In this case just select start sensor from the menu in xDrip. The transmitter will ignore the sensor start as it is already started.
That's what I've been thinking. However, it doesn't give me the option to start a sensor. It only gives the option to stop sensor.

Ok if you see "Sensor Stopped" at the bottom of the screen this indicates the transmitter thinks the sensor session is stopped. In this situation use the "Stop Sensor" menu item then wait 10 minutes or so and then do "Start Sensor"

I stopped and started the sensor again. It's went through warm-up, but never read anything. It still says "stopped" below the graph even though I started the sensor. It's now saying "session start failed".
@mduggan0208 may I ask you to share your experience here #1236 ? I'm sure that would help others struggling with similar problems.

I'm currently struggling with a similar issue, too. I want to change from a Pixel 3a to a 3a XL while a sensor session is running. I'm using the same xdrip version, settings(via QR code) and android version. The 'old' 3a is running perfectly fine but the new XL does not receive any readings. It connects to the G6 transmitter (8Gxxxx) but only reports scanning errors. I selected "start sensor", selected current time and entered the calibration code.

That's exactly what mine is doing. I'm just getting errors over and over. The sensor I'm using is 8Kxxxx. As soon as I start a sensor it says "sensor stopped". I've tried switching the Bluetooth AVRCP because I heard that was an issue with Android 10. Still haven't got anything. Please let me now if you figure anything out!!

The phone just started to collect data after about one hour. The only change I made is the phone's bluetooth name from "Pixel 3a XL" to " Pixel3aXL". Some time ago I read a post where this was considered a problem. I think it is not, because the other phone has a whitespace in the name too. Well and I reatarted the phone a couple of times. But I guess you also did that.


@jamorham Even after receiving data from the already running sensor, the warm up message did not disappear until the timer ran out.
In my S10 + MiaoMiao (Libre), I disabled the Trust Auto-Connect in Less Common Settings-> BlueTooth Settings and it connected successfully

Ugh, I've taken the space out of my Bluetooth name and disabled trust auto connect on my Pixel. I'm still not getting any readings. It looks like my transmitter is paired in more phone settings, but it won't show on xdrip+.

@mduggan0208 Would you please close this issue if the problem has been resolved?
If not, you can find detail G6 start instructions here:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/permalink/4838757582864365
Thanks
